sources.title: Recap: Miami thrashes Pitt 52-23
sources.description: The University of Miami honored the 2001 national championship team on Saturday. And the 2026 version proved that imitation is the best form of flattery by flattening the Pitt Panthers 52-23 wearing those 2001 throwback jerseys (which looked incredible). Malachi Toney was a man among boys, setting a school record with 16 catches that he […]
